pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal patches with predominantly smooth-gradient edges and rounded vertices. Spatial area is greater on the upper flank and shoulder regions, transitioning to smaller geometries on the distal limb area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: An interconnected network of light-colored pathways forming a topological graph with numerous 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and exhibits high continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark mane is visible along the dorsal neck, presenting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated geometric contour against the background.
